likely_causes.cause: Closed or blocked registers and returns
Blower not running on a fan or cool call
Dirty indoor coil or duct restriction

homeowner_checks: Replace the filter with the correct size and orientation
Open all supply registers and clear furniture from returns
Confirm the thermostat Fan setting is On or Auto as intended
Listen at the air handler for blower noise during a call
call_pro_when: Filter and vents are clear but blower amps stay near zero during a call, or high delta-T continues after a clean filter.
assumptions: Airflow problems are checked before refrigerant work
